items.evidence: README's play command (and play on the parent folder) with --ticks 1 printed one JSON object with every brief key: screen title, menu_index 0, texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit], tick 1; score/wave/... null before a run.
play ... --frame judge-scratch/play.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; `file` reports 800 x 480 RGBA. Same for title, settings and lost frames.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 2:down,4:enter gave screen settings; 1:enter gave screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, guard_y 6 at tick 2.
In settings, 5 rights from 8 held at 10 (then left gave 9); 14 lefts went to 0 and stayed 0 (ticks 16..32).

Down,Right on Language: settings texts became [Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Espanol, Atras] (title underneath Defiende la puerta/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir); back on title then Start: play texts [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], pause [En pausa, Continuar, Titulo], lost [Has perdido, Puntos: 0, Enter: titulo]. No English left.
Run with --settings judge-scratch/keep1 set volume 5, language es; a second run with the same folder started at title with volume 5, es, Spanish texts; a fresh folder started with volume 8, en.
Up held 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9; down 60 ticks: 9 -> 3; long up stops at 12, long down stops at 0; x is fixed at 2 (bolts spawn at x 2).
Shoot held from tick 10: new bolts at ticks 11, 35, 59 (24 apart); each moves 0.2333/tick (14/s); a bolt at x 19.97 on tick 87 is gone at tick 88.
No input after Start: walkers appear at x 20 on ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (every 90), lanes 4,10,6,2,6, moving 0.025/tick (1.5/s); still 5 at tick 460 and 700, no sixth.

Seed 1, guard at y 4, one bolt at tick 30 hit the lane-4 walker (health 2->1, bolt gone). A second bolt fired at tick 60 in the same lane passed through it: tick 124 bolt x 16.933 / walker x 16.95, tick 125 bolt x 17.167 / walker x 16.925, walker still health 1, bolt flew on to x 19.5 and left. The swept check compares the walker's new x with the bolt's old x, so a crossing is missed (about 1 in 10 bolts). Kills otherwise give +10 (score 10 at tick 130 with continuous fire); a bolt in lane 6 passes a lane-4 walker.

No input: walker reaching x 0 at tick 802 is gone at 803 and gate 5 -> 4, next at 893 -> 3; at gate 0 screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 10, Enter: title] in a run that scored 10; lost frame shows it.

With the README's winning script: wave 1's last walker destroyed at tick 725, wave 2 at tick 905 (180 ticks = 3 s), first wave-2 walker at 906; 7 spawns at 906..1446 every 90 ticks, none at 1536; HUD text 'Wave 2 of 5' (Spanish 'Oleada 2 de 5' seen in another run).

The engine's find produced a 6375-tick script; replayed with play it ends screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]. Enter on the won screen (README's 440 script + 6560:enter) returns to the title.

Escape at tick 50: state (walker x 18.8, bolt x 6.667, guard 8) unchanged through tick 199; Enter (Resume) at 200 continues: tick 210 equals an unpaused reference run's tick 60 exactly. Escape, Down, Enter goes to the title.
Seed 42, 900 ticks, same script: two outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 43 gives walker lanes 2,6,4 instead of 4,10,4; seed 7 vs 1 at tick 700 also differ.

Frame at tick 300 (play.png): gate strip at left, guard at (80,120) = (2,9), bolts at y 9 at x 5.03/10.63/16.23 -> px 201/425/649, walkers (14.8,10),(17.05,6, health 1 drawn orange),(19.3,2) at matching pixels (40 px/unit); HUD 'Score: 10 Wave 1 of 5 Gate: 5'.

title.png: Hold the gate with Start/Settings/Quit, Settings marked with a focus ring (menu_index 1); settings_es.png: Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Espanol (ringed), Atras; title_es.png: Defiende la puerta, Empezar/Ajustes/Salir with Salir ringed.

assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold every word; ui screens use @keys (title uses {game.title}, which shows the Spanish name); lib.rs has no shown words; README 'Adding a language' says copy en.json, set locale and name, translate.
README 'How to play' covers controls, waves, win/lose; its headless and frame commands ran as written (from work/) and printed the state / wrote an 800x480 PNG.

defects: On the first tick after Start the HUD texts are raw placeholders: ['Score: {game.score}', 'Wave {work.wave} of 5', 'Gate: {work.gate}'] with score/wave null (tick 1 of a 1:enter run).
Bolt-walker collision misses crossings (walker new x vs bolt old x), so a bolt can pass a walker in its own lane; this is why the builder's own winning script ends at 440, not 450.
Guard is allowed to y 0 and y 12, i.e. half drawn outside the field at the edges.
After returning to the title, the JSON still reports the last run's score/wave/walkers (README admits it).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4

steps.what: cd <run>/work && ls -R . | head -50 && cat notes/how.md game.json modules/*/src/lib.rs modules/*/actions.js...
cd <run>/work && cat assets/ui/title.json assets/ui/pause.json assets/ui/won.json; cat modules/work/Cargo.t...
cd <run>/work && rm -rf checks && cat assets/ui/lost.json | head -5; cat assets/style.json | head -20; grep...
cd <run>/work && python - <<'E' p='modules/work/src/lib.rs' s=open(p).read() a=s.index(" .map(|b| {") b=s.i...
examen leverage play . --ticks 3000 --inputs "0:enter" --at 1000,2000,3000 2>&1 | cut -c1-330 $E leverage f...
examen leverage play . --ticks 6555 --inputs "$IN" 2>&1 | cut -c1-400 $E leverage play . --ticks 1500 --inp...

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger

steps.what: cd <run>; cat run.json; echo; cat work/game.json work/specula.project.json work/.gitignore; ls -R work/note...
cd <run>/work; ls notes modules/work modules/work/src; cat modules/work/actions.json; cat assets/strings/en...
cd <run>/work; cat notes/checks.md; grep -n -i "settings\|--at\|--keys\|pause" notes/how.md | head -60
mkdir -p <run>/judge-scratch; cd <run>/work; sed -n 40,100p notes/how.md; cat assets/ui/settings.json
examen leverage play . --ticks 10 --inputs "2:down,4:enter" --at 3,6 2>&1 | tail -2 echo --- start "$E" lev...
examen leverage play . --ticks 40 --inputs "$IN" --at 16,18,20,32 --keys volume 2>&1 | tail -4 echo --- lan...
examen leverage play . --ticks 300 --inputs "1:enter,5:down" --keys tick,guard_y 2>&1 | tail -1 echo --- sh...
cd <run>/work; grep -n '"text"' assets/ui/*.json | grep -v '"@'; grep -n '"' modules/work/src/lib.rs | grep...
